title: Listening Drill — Accessibility audit
description: Student and tutor dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Accessibility audit
sections.transcript:
STUDENT: I've started the project on wheelchair access to lecture halls. I was going to use a questionnaire, but testing it with one person made me realise that the questions were too broad.

TUTOR: In that case, try walkthroughs first. But watch out for blocked routes. That can affect what you notice and what you end up writing down.

STUDENT: Would it help if I kept a daily log? I don't want to discover the problem only after I've handed everything in.

TUTOR: A better safeguard here is repeat visits. Bring the floor plan to our next meeting, so we can check which buildings to visit first. There is no need to prepare the final presentation yet.
